summary: Frontend testing completed for Discover and Rewards navigation integration. All navigation features working correctly on both mobile (400px) and desktop (1920px) viewports.
passed_tests: Desktop header shows: Home, Discover, Rewards (yellow highlight), My List (when logged in), Coming Soon
Mobile bottom nav shows: Home, Discover, Rewards (yellow highlight), Store, Profile
Rewards link highlighted in yellow on both mobile and desktop
/rewards route loads RewardsPage with sign-in prompt for unauthenticated users
/rewards route shows full rewards content for authenticated users
Discover page has: category cards (Trending Now, Top Rated, New Releases, Quick Bites)
Discover page has: content sections (Picked For You, Trending This Week, Highest Rated, If You Like Romance, Quick Bites, Just Added)
Discover page has: Refresh button, series cards with thumbnails
Rewards page has: Daily Reward section with Claim button
Rewards page has: Lucky Spin wheel with Spin Now button
Rewards page has: Daily Missions section (1/5 completed, Watch 3 Episodes mission)
Rewards page has: Invite Friends referral CTA
Rewards page has: Coin balance display (Your Balance)
Navigation between Home, Discover, Rewards works correctly on desktop
Navigation between Home, Discover, Rewards, Store, Profile works correctly on mobile
Protected routes (Store, Profile) show auth modal for unauthenticated users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation integration complete. Routes /discover and /rewards are working. DiscoverPage shows personalized content recommendations. RewardsPage shows sign-in prompt for unauthenticated users and full rewards content (daily reward, spin wheel, missions, referral) for authenticated users. Promo popup may appear on page load - close with X button or press Escape.
